title: The ofch family is a nominal content class while chor compounds switch role by complete whole
summary: Use GDT766's exact census to distinguish a portable ofch-bearing nominal class from role-conditioned complete chor/pchor/schor/lchor wholes.

design.mechanism: The recurrent ofch-bearing complete forms occupy a nominal drug/preparation field, while chor-family compounds are learned wholes whose roles depend on the complete form and slot.
design.unit: Complete reader-exact forms containing ofch or chor-family surfaces with independently coded field role, position, and same-line part/content context.
design.contrast: Shared substring/class meaning versus complete-whole role conditioning.
design.prediction: ofch-bearing forms retain a common early nominal-field profile, whereas chor derivatives separate into content, opening, subentry and internal-preparation profiles after whole identity and position controls.
design.falsifier: If complete chor-family forms share one role after controls, or ofch-bearing forms lack a common nominal-field profile, this mixed class/whole hypothesis fails.
design.scope: GDT766 cached exact forms; no EVA substring meaning or independent material identity; binding availability_unknown.
design.related: Near GDT766 and IDEA000015/27 part/material families; it is a whole-versus-family role question, not a new botanical gloss.
design.countermodel: Section or register can create apparent role clusters while all forms have one portable nominal meaning.

design_source_evidence.quote:
# GDT766 report — nominal `ofch` wholes and role-switched `chor` wholes

## Result

The best current model is a mixed learned-whole/register system.

- The 25 observed complete words containing `ofch` behave collectively like
  early nominal drug or preparation fields. That is the portable result.
- Flower material remains the most useful concrete family analogy, but only as
  a replaceable C0 working layer attached to observed complete words.
- `chor`, `pchor`, `schor` and `lchor` cannot be rendered as one common plant
  noun. Their complete-word positions separate into content, opening,
  subentry and internal-preparation roles.
- Five complete lines now contain a visible default for all 46 exact tokens.
  A final adversarial edit removed hidden actions and attachments from the
  fluent German without discarding the concrete candidate meanings.

The validator passes 5,294 checks and byte-identically rebuilds all 22 declared
outputs. No new page, image or transcription was used.
